parts.title: Match the cooking words with their meanings.
parts.html:
• boiled ↔ H. cooked in boiling water
  • fried ↔ D. cooked in hot oil
  • steamed ↔ F. cooked using steam
  • grilled ↔ A. cooked on a grill
  • mashed ↔ G. crushed until soft and smooth
  • pickled ↔ B. kept in vinegar
  • scrambled ↔ E. mixed together while cooking (eggs)
  • poached ↔ C. cooked gently in hot water

parts.title: Read the sentences and circle the correct words.
parts.html:
1. Dad cooks eggs in a pan with oil. He makes [boiled | fried ✓ | poached] eggs.
2. Mum cooks potatoes and crushes them. She makes [baked | roast | mashed ✓] potatoes.
3. We cook broccoli using steam. We make [steamed ✓ | pickled | boiled] vegetables.
4. Grandma keeps cucumbers in vinegar. She makes [grilled | pickled ✓ | steamed] vegetables.
5. Jack cooks fish on a grill. He makes [fried | baked | grilled ✓] fish.
6. Emma mixes eggs together while cooking them. She makes [scrambled ✓ | boiled | poached] eggs.
7. Ben cooks a whole potato in the oven. He makes a [mashed | baked ✓ | boiled] potato.
8. Mia cooks an egg without its shell in gently heated water. She makes a [fried | scrambled | poached ✓] egg.
